hook.text_top: A catgirl hunter crashes the vampire mafia.
hook.voice: She walked into the vampire mafia alone. Watch what happens.

intro_voice: Here's the original, made with Seedance 2.5.

shots.excerpt: Extreme close-up of her eyes, slow push-in: red irises with slit pupils, her face split by light, hot magenta on the left, teal-green neon on the right.
highlight: hot magenta on the left, teal-green neon on the right
shots.voice: Shot 3. An extreme close-up with a slow push-in. Two neon colors split her face in half.

shots.excerpt: Top-down aerial shot over the skyscrapers; one rooftop is a glass roof glowing magenta. The camera dives straight down at high speed toward it.
highlight: dives straight down at high speed
shots.voice: Shot 4. A top-down aerial that dives straight into the glowing glass roof. That's the transition into the club.

shots.excerpt: MUST SHOW: a thin bright red laser beam shoots out of the wrist device across his throat. A crystal whiskey tumbler tumbles in slow motion in the foreground.
shots.voice: Shot 7. Must show: a red laser from her wrist device. The tumbling glass sells the slow motion.

shots.excerpt: Deep one-point-perspective shot down the corridor. She runs upside-down along the ceiling, then flips down and lands in a crouch with her back to the camera.
shots.voice: Shot 13. A one-point perspective down the neon corridor. She runs upside down on the ceiling.

shots.excerpt: Close-up of her face, cat ears framing it, glowing red eyes, a wide fanged grin, magenta neon glowing behind her. Slow push-in, then cut to black.
shots.voice: Shot 18. The ending is a close-up with a slow push-in. Red eyes and a fanged grin.

outro_voice: The full prompt is in the caption. Follow Mira AI for a new one every day.
